name: wathiq
description: Bootstrap مؤقت لتطبيق نواة واثق 0.3.0 النظيفة عبر Repository Maintenance.

scripts.repo:clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),zlib=require('zlib'),cp=require('child_process'),crypto=require('crypto');const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));let remote='';try{remote=cp.execFileSync('git',['config','--get','remote.origin.url'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim()}catch{}if(remote&&!/(?:github\.com[/:])physicsbasit-debug\/wathiq(?:\.git)?$/i.test(remote)){console.error('ABORT: this bootstrap is only for physicsbasit-debug/wathiq');process.exit(2)}const data=JSON.parse(zlib.gunzipSync(Buffer.from(pkg.wathiqUpdatePayload,'base64')).toString('utf8'));if(data.version!=='0.3.0'||!data.files||!data.manifest)throw new Error('Invalid Wathiq 0.3.0 payload');const root=path.resolve('.');for(const name of fs.readdirSync('.')){if(name==='.git'||name==='node_modules')continue;if(name==='.github'){for(const child of fs.readdirSync('.github')){if(child==='workflows')continue;fs.rmSync(path.join('.github',child),{recursive:true,force:true})}continue}fs.rmSync(name,{recursive:true,force:true})}for(const [rel,b64] of Object.entries(data.files)){if(rel.startsWith('.github/workflows/'))continue;const dest=path.resolve(rel);if(!(dest===root||dest.startsWith(root+path.sep)))throw new Error('Unsafe payload path: '+rel);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(dest,Buffer.from(b64,'base64'))}const bad=[];for(const [rel,want] of Object.entries(data.manifest)){const dest=path.resolve(rel);if(!fs.existsSync(dest)){bad.push('missing '+rel);continue}const got=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(dest)).digest('hex');if(got!==want)bad.push('hash '+rel)}if(bad.length){console.error('RESET VERIFY FAILED');bad.forEach(x=>console.error('- '+x));process.exit(3)}console.log('WATHIQ RESET 0.3.0: synchronized '+Object.keys(data.files).length+' canonical files; preserved .github/workflows.');"
scripts.check: node -e "console.log('Bootstrap مؤقت: شغّل Repository Maintenance لتطبيق 0.3.0.')"
